note: Vercel project IDs for the sites built here (not secrets). Deploy with `npm run build && npm run deploy:sites`. Each world's address under bitblocks.network is attached to its project; the project names are older than the addresses.

airlock.note: The reference Airlock, kept as a second implementation. The worlds here send visitors through BitPortal's.

templateDemo.note: The Starter Home: deployed from a copy of the nswp-world-template repo; see sites/template-demo/README.md.

godotDemo.note: The Foundry: the Godot example in engines/godot, exported by npm run build:godot. Needs Godot 4 and its web export templates on the machine that deploys.
